fields.summary_ko.0: CrowdStrike (CRWD) has experienced 6 major market shocks since June 2019, declining over 40% in 3 of them, and fell 10.5% over the past month.
fields.summary_ko.1: CRWD achieved 12-month revenue of $5.4 billion with 24.3% YoY growth, with net loss narrowed to 2.2% of revenue, showing financial improvement.
fields.summary_ko.2: Company has sufficient cash at $5.01 billion versus debt of $820 million, with Q3 revenue guidance expecting approximately 24% YoY growth.
